case.name: group_after_points
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT sum(x) AS x FROM (SELECT unicode(substr(CAST(t.payload AS TEXT),-1,1)) AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE t.grp<4 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.id=t.seq AND u.v>=t.v)) GROUP BY grp);
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=1+(c.i*2654435761)%65536)) FROM c;
